name: spll
description: SPLL システム（Google Apps Script + clasp）／ SPLL-SYS-BD-001

scripts.create: clasp create --type webapp --title "SPLL 利用申込窓口" --rootDir spll_src
scripts.setup: clasp create --type webapp --title "SPLL 利用申込窓口" --rootDir spll_src && git checkout -- spll_src/appsscript.json && clasp push -f
scripts.push:portal: npm run build && cd apps/portal && clasp push -f
scripts.push:workflow: npm run build && cd apps/workflow && clasp push -f
scripts.push:admin: npm run build && cd apps/admin && clasp push -f
scripts.push:all: npm run build && cd apps/portal && clasp push -f && cd ../workflow && clasp push -f && cd ../admin && clasp push -f
